_comment: FactionDef. Cascade: the REGION sets the baseline view; a FACTION deviates from it via its Weights (and interaction standing); a SUB-FACTION (Parent set) deviates from its parent; an NPC deviates further. Region_Sensitivity (0-1) = how much the region's overall mood colors this faction (civilians ~0.9 follow the room; zealots/ancients ~0.2 are immovable). Region 'Global' = cross-nation; judged in whatever region the interaction happens (manager follow-up needed). Status 'defunct' = leaderless/destroyed but kept for history.

factions.Name: Knights of Favonius
factions.Notes: Mondstadt's protectors. The party were named Honorary Knights of Mondstadt.

factions.Name: Liyue Qixing
factions.Notes: The human government of Liyue (the doc's 'Chiseng'). Pragmatic, image-conscious; will scapegoat for stability (Ningguang).

factions.Name: The Adepti
factions.Notes: Ancient illuminated beasts who guard Liyue. Long memory, easily roused to vengeance.

factions.Name: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
factions.Notes: Hu Tao's parlor; keepers of Liyue's funerary rites and the balance of life and death (Zhongli works here).

factions.Name: Crux Fleet
factions.Notes: Beidou's free-roving sailors; loyal to crew, tolerant of smuggling, scornful of cowards.

factions.Name: Tenryou Commission
factions.Notes: Military/police arm of the Tri-Commission (Kujou clan); enforces the Vision Hunt Decree.

factions.Name: Kanjou Commission
factions.Notes: Customs/finance/border arm (Hiiragi clan); gatekeepers who throttle information to the Raiden and distrust outsiders.

factions.Name: Yashiro Commission
factions.Notes: Festivals/shrines arm (Kamisato clan); believes people should keep their visions. Sympathetic to the party.

factions.Name: Watatsumi Army
factions.Notes: Kokomi's resistance against the Vision Hunt Decree. The party served as legion captains.

factions.Name: The Shogunate
factions.Notes: The Raiden Shogun's direct divine authority and the Raiden's puppet's enforcement of eternity. Respects worthy challengers via duel; brands vision-holders enemies of eternity.

factions.Name: The Akademiya
factions.Notes: Governs Sumeru in Kusanali's name (Grand Sage Azar). Worships knowledge, hoards information, dismisses arts/dreams as worthless.

factions.Name: Forest Watchers
factions.Notes: Avidya forest rangers (Tighnari, Collei); steward the rainforest and the withering, wary of reckless outsiders.

factions.Name: Followers of Lesser Lord Kusanali
factions.Notes: The small faithful of Nahida (Dunyarzad, Nilou); keep festivals and the arts alive despite Akademiya scorn.

factions.Name: The Aranara
factions.Notes: Hidden nature spirits with power over dreams; only a few can see them. Innocent, protective of the forest.

factions.Name: Eremites
factions.Notes: Desert mercenary bands. Respect strength and coin; despise weakness and broken contracts.

factions.Name: Fatui
factions.Notes: Snezhnayan diplomatic/military order serving the Cryo Archon. Diplomacy as a mask for power-grabbing; ruthless means. Parent of the Harbinger cells below.

factions.Name: Childe's Vanguard
factions.Notes: 11th Harbinger Tartaglia's following. Lives for the fight; respects worthy opponents. Now warm to the party after their brawl.

factions.Name: Signora's Retinue
factions.Notes: 8th Harbinger La Signora's following. DEFUNCT — Signora was disintegrated by the Raiden after losing a death-duel to the party.

factions.Name: Scaramouche's Unit
factions.Notes: 6th Harbinger the Balladeer's following; arrogant and contemptuous. (Scaramouche himself is a discarded puppet of the Raiden.)

factions.Name: Dottore's Researchers
factions.Notes: The Doctor's research arm; amoral experimentation ('questionable treatments', e.g. Collei's alazar).

factions.Name: Fatui Skirmishers
factions.Notes: Rank-and-file delusion users; obedient, aggressive, expendable.

factions.Name: Abyss Order
factions.Notes: Corrupt faction spreading chaos; tied to Khaenri'ah's fall and the Cataclysm. Enemy of every nation.

factions.Name: Khaenri'ah Remnants
factions.Notes: Survivors and ghosts of the fallen godless nation (Dainsleif, Halfdan, the cursed). Prize resilience, defiance, and restoring Khaenri'ah; internally split over how far that justifies going (the party's royal spouses take the extreme view).

factions.Name: Celestia
factions.Notes: The heavenly overseers ('management'). Guardians of divine order and the gnosis contracts. The demon who cast the party down and took their spouses serves Celestia; the party are fallen gods who defied it.

factions.Name: HexenZirkel
factions.Notes: Reclusive circle of witches who transcended mortality (Alice, Gold, Mona's master). Prize brilliance, curiosity, and audacity.

factions.Name: Adventurers' Guild
factions.Notes: Neutral service org present in every nation (the various Catherines). Transactional; rewards competence and reliability.

factions.Name: Commonfolk
factions.Notes: Ordinary townspeople, shopkeepers, villagers. Almost entirely echo the regional mood; lightly favor kindness and protection, fear killers.

factions.Name: Desert Tribes
factions.Notes: The confederated peoples of the Great Red Sand, heirs of King Deshret. Scorn the rainforest cities, the Akademiya and Kusanali alike; answer to strength, grievance and blood-debt rather than law. Dylan raised them into a nation-wide rebellion on Day 20.

factions.Name: Deseret's Relics
factions.Notes: Eremite raider band that repeatedly went after Dunyarzad. DEFUNCT - the party wiped them out on Day 19 after uncovering who was arming them.
